title: Owner decision: rule on bug-compatibility candidates C-1..C-11
description: The port reproduces each oddity of toon 0.2.4 (decoded integers print as 1.0; JSON number input not correctly rounded; two JSON escape tables; 8192-byte silent write loss; encode->decode breaks S10.83 and S10.200; ...). Each is listed in docs/DISCREPANCIES.md for the owner; a fix needs a DISC with a kill-switch.

title: Complete interpreter-lane run with a full log at the certified commit
description: The lanes run at d068470 gave interpreter 1004/1005 with the failing case name lost; not reproduced when the 26 heaviest cases ran alone. Run scripts/lanes.sh with a full log on a quiet host; on a failure run scripts/first-divergence.sh on the named case.

title: Owner decision: license and git remote for toon_bend
description: The repository has no LICENSE and no remote; AGENTS.md landing-the-plane wants git push. toon_rust's license was deliberately not copied.

title: Laws: state unescape_escape and the decoder bound law if the checker affords them
description: PROPOSED_ARCHITECTURE section 8 planned unescape_escape (round trip) and section 11 A2 names the decoder's bound-never-reached property. Both need induction over texts with abstract U32 comparisons; not attempted in Phase 3.

title: Owner decision: remove the stray files ./- and docs/AGENTS.scaffold.md
description: ./- is a 1-byte file written by a Phase 1 probe (-o -); docs/AGENTS.scaffold.md is a needless copy. RULE 1: deletion needs the owner's exact command.

title: Phase 5 candidate: JSON reader and string paths are about 10x the original on string-heavy input
description: 7000 short strings: port 34 ms, original 4.6 ms (maintenance numbers). Per-byte state rebuild in J.step, six passes in E.needs_quote, several list reversals between bytes and text. Profile first (gprof on the emitted C works; perf is not permitted on this host).

title: Phase 5: cv-gated captures for EXP-001..003 on a quiet host
description: perf/EXPERIMENTS.md cards EXP-001 (integer printer), EXP-002 (short integer texts), EXP-003 (power-of-ten short division). Run scripts/incumbent-bench.sh per card; ledger every outcome (PERF-LEDGER or NEGATIVE-EVIDENCE with a retry predicate). The host was shared (load about 5) during development.

title: Phase 5 candidate: reuse a short decimal's own digits when printing (EXP-004, not carded yet)
description: For a number text of at most 15 significant digits and a small exponent both readers return the nearest binary64, whose shortest digits are the text's own digits (DBL_DIG argument). The shortest-digit generator costs 19-56 microseconds per decimal; this would skip it. Needs a card, a Json field for the digits, twins, closed laws, native comparison.

title: Owner decision: accept or reject DISC-001..006 (six Platform divergences)
description: docs/DISCREPANCIES.md lists six OPEN Platform divergences (runtime flags before --, literal program name toon, unwritable stderr, non-UTF-8 argv, ANSI styling, failed stdout write text). converge.sh and the SHIP verdict need each ACCEPTED, REVERTED or RESOLVED with an approver. Only the repository owner can approve.
